name: Repository home
tagline: Files, README, stats, star and fork
summary: The front page of a repository: files, latest commit, README and other docs, and a side panel with stats, topics, releases and contributors. Its header carries star, fork and the repo tabs.

flow.label: Repo index route
flow.note: Prefetches the overview and viewer, plus the tree and README when the overview is already cached.

flow.label: RepoOverviewPage
flow.note: Reads the cached overview and lays out the toolbar, banners, file list, docs and side panel.

flow.label: getRepoOverview
flow.note: One GraphQL query for repo facts and counts, plus a user-token query for the star state.

flow.label: GitHub GraphQL
flow.note: Returns description, default branch tip, stars, forks, topics and open pull request and issue counts.

flow.label: RepoSidebar
flow.note: Shows stats, topics, recent releases and contributors; releases and contributors load on their own.

flow.label: Repo tab store
flow.note: Keeps each user's choice of visible repo tabs in localStorage and syncs it across browser tabs.

features.name: Overview page
features.summary: Root files with each entry's last commit, a latest-commit bar and the branch toolbar; other branches reuse the same page through the tree route.

features.name: About panel
features.summary: Description, fork parent, star, watcher and fork counts, links to branches and tags, topics, recent releases and top contributors.

features.name: Star and fork
features.summary: Star flips at once in the cached overview and rolls back with a toast on failure; fork opens the new fork when GitHub has created it.

features.name: Repo tabs
features.summary: Ten repo sections; each user picks which show as tabs and the rest sit in a menu. Settings shows only with triage access or higher. Map shows when the repository has a product map, or marked New for people who can push one.

features.name: README and docs
features.summary: README, license, contributing, security and changelog files appear as pills; one opens on click and its content prefetches on hover.

features.name: Branch banners
features.summary: On the default branch, your own push in the last 2 hours offers Compare & pull request; other branches show how far ahead or behind they are.

features.name: Clone menu
features.summary: Copy an HTTPS, SSH or GitHub CLI clone command, or download a zip. The chosen protocol is remembered in localStorage.
